quality_basis.additional_2021_items: REHVA Table 2 also lists cylindrical 150 lx, wall 150 lx and ceiling 100 lx with surface uniformity >=0.10. These are not proved by the four course metrics. Do not claim complete EN 12464-1 conformity without addressing them and other applicable requirements.
quality_basis.modified_illuminance: No special critical/small/low-contrast/prolonged task or impaired-vision brief supplied. Use course's 500 lx baseline; re-evaluate context modifiers if activity assumptions change. No daylight is credited in the electric-light calculation.

energy_basis.project_assumption: Academic design of a normal daytime office; adopt BEC 2024 lighting provisions as design criteria. Actual installation dates and statutory applicability are unspecified, so this is not regulatory certification.
energy_basis.lpd_reference: Table 5.4, printed page 16 / PDF page 22; clauses 5.1 and 5.4.1-5.4.3 reviewed with complete fixed-lighting power basis
energy_basis.manual_controls: Table 5.5, PDF page 24: at 1042.10 m2 the unreduced base number is 32 control points (1000 < A <=1050). Do not substitute occupant sensors for these control points. Any reduction under 5.5.2 must be separately calculated; default design should retain 32.

automatic_controls.design_intent: Propose zero general-lighting power after 10 minutes vacancy, independently zoned; verify actual zone mapping before claiming satisfaction.

energy_basis.daylight: 5.6.1.2 and 5.6.2 apply when exterior fenestration is provided. Supplied drawing lacks a defined glazing schedule. Preserve daylight control as an explicit design provision/conditional requirement; do not treat missing glazing information as an exemption.
